welcome:
Welcome to the Grafana CLI Playground.
Type commands to explore a simulated Grafana instance with Prometheus and Loki data sources.
Type 'help' for available commands, 'scenario' for guided labs.

steps.instruction: First, check which plugins are currently installed on this Grafana instance.
Install the pie chart panel plugin to use in our dashboard.
Good. Now search for available dashboards related to Node Exporter via the API.
No results yet. Import the popular Node Exporter Full dashboard (ID 1860) from grafana.com.
steps.hint: Try: curl -s -X POST http://localhost:3000/api/dashboards/import -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'Authorization: Bearer eyJrIjoiT0...' -d '{...}'

steps.instruction: Now create a folder called 'SRE Dashboards' to organise our dashboards.
steps.expect: curl -s -X POST http://localhost:3000/api/folders -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'Authorization: Bearer eyJrIjoiT0...' -d '{"title":"SRE Dashboards"}'
steps.hint: Try: curl -s -X POST http://localhost:3000/api/folders -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'Authorization: Bearer eyJrIjoiT0...' -d '{"title":"SRE Dashboards"}'

steps.instruction: List all folders to confirm our new folder was created.
Move our imported dashboard into the SRE Dashboards folder (folder ID: 5).
steps.expect: curl -s -X POST http://localhost:3000/api/dashboards/db -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'Authorization: Bearer eyJrIjoiT0...' -d '{"dashboard":{"uid":"node-exporter-full","title":"Node Exporter Full"},"folderId":5,"overwrite":true}'
steps.hint: Try: curl -s -X POST http://localhost:3000/api/dashboards/db -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'Authorization: Bearer eyJrIjoiT0...' -d '{...}'

steps.instruction: Finally, verify the dashboard is in the correct folder by searching within SRE Dashboards.
List all currently configured data sources.
Add a Prometheus data source pointing to your monitoring stack.
steps.expect: curl -s -X POST http://localhost:3000/api/datasources -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'Authorization: Bearer eyJrIjoiT0...' -d '{"name":"Prometheus","type":"prometheus","url":"http://prometheus:9090","access":"proxy","isDefault":true}'
steps.hint: Try: curl -s -X POST http://localhost:3000/api/datasources -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'Authorization: Bearer eyJrIjoiT0...' -d '{"name":"Prometheus",...}'

steps.instruction: Add a Loki data source for log aggregation alongside Prometheus.
steps.expect: curl -s -X POST http://localhost:3000/api/datasources -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'Authorization: Bearer eyJrIjoiT0...' -d '{"name":"Loki","type":"loki","url":"http://loki:3100","access":"proxy"}'
steps.hint: Try: curl -s -X POST http://localhost:3000/api/datasources -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'Authorization: Bearer eyJrIjoiT0...' -d '{"name":"Loki",...}'

steps.instruction: Test the Prometheus data source to verify connectivity.
Check the health of the Loki data source.
Update the Prometheus data source to add a 15s scrape interval.
steps.expect: curl -s -X PUT http://localhost:3000/api/datasources/1 -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'Authorization: Bearer eyJrIjoiT0...' -d '{"name":"Prometheus","type":"prometheus","url":"http://prometheus:9090","access":"proxy","isDefault":true,"jsonData":{"timeInterval":"15s"}}'
steps.hint: Try: curl -s -X PUT http://localhost:3000/api/datasources/1 -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'Authorization: Bearer eyJrIjoiT0...' -d '{...}'

steps.instruction: List data sources again to confirm both are configured correctly.
Delete a legacy InfluxDB data source that is no longer needed (ID: 3).
steps.hint: Try: curl -s -X DELETE http://localhost:3000/api/datasources/3 -H 'Authorization: Bearer eyJrIjoiT0...'

commands.help:
Available commands:
  grafana-cli plugins ls              — List installed plugins
  grafana-cli plugins install [name]  — Install a plugin
  grafana-cli plugins update [name]   — Update a plugin
  grafana-cli plugins remove [name]   — Remove a plugin
  grafana-cli plugins list-remote     — List available remote plugins
  grafana-cli admin reset-admin-password — Reset admin password
  grafana server status               — Check Grafana server status
  curl ... /api/datasources           — Manage data sources
  curl ... /api/dashboards            — Manage dashboards
  curl ... /api/alerts                — Manage alerts
  curl ... /api/users                 — Manage users
  curl ... /api/orgs                  — Manage organisations
  curl ... /api/folders               — Manage folders

  scenario                            — Start a guided lab
  clear                               — Clear the terminal
  help                                — Show this help
